record.question: He is not so strong as his brother.
record.explanation: Answer C: Adverb clause. “As his brother [is]” is an elliptical comparative clause; it functions adverbially. Independent check: The elliptical clause “as his brother [is strong]” completes the comparison and functions adverbially. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/comparatives-and-superlatives. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Directions (Question 28 to 35): Identify the kind of the subordinate clause in the given sentences.
record.questionMarkup: He is not <u>so strong as his brother</u>.
